name: Abul Kalam Azad
shortMessage: At Prime Institute, we believe every student carries a spark of brilliance. Our role is to fan that spark into a flame — through patient teaching, honest guidance, and an environment where curiosity is celebrated.
fullMessage: When I founded Prime Institute in 2015, I had one simple dream — to build a place where students from Assamese-medium schools could receive the same quality of education that students in English-medium schools take for granted. Today, a decade later, that dream has grown into a thriving community of over 1,200 learners and 18 dedicated teachers.

Education, in my view, is not just about scoring marks. It is about developing character, sharpening curiosity, and preparing young minds to face life's challenges with confidence. Whether a student is preparing for their SEBA Class X examinations or dreaming of an AHSEC Commerce distinction, we walk alongside them at every step — correcting, encouraging, and inspiring.

Our computer lab, science project guidance, and Olympiad coaching are not extras — they are essential parts of how we build complete students. In today's world, an Assamese-medium student must feel equally at home with a textbook and a keyboard. That is the promise of Prime Institute.
To every parent who has trusted us, and to every student who has walked through our doors — thank you. Your belief in us is what keeps the Prime Institute family growing, year after year.
quote: Teach the mind. Touch the heart. Transform the life.
